name: React + Vite
description: Project-level React frontend scaffold powered by Vite and TypeScript.
longDescription: React is a UI library and Vite is its build tool. They belong in each project's node_modules, not on the operating system. DevForge treats this as a project recipe: it ensures Node.js is installed and provides the official Vite scaffold commands.
caveats: React and Vite are installed per project into node_modules, not globally.
DevForge does not create project files; it provides the official scaffold commands.

dependencies.reason: Vite requires a modern Node.js runtime.

projectRecipe.summary: Scaffold a React + TypeScript application with Vite inside your project folder.
notes: These commands create a new folder named my-app in the current directory.
